title: SEC1: Document fancy-regex version pinning and upgrade path
description:
fancy-regex is pinned at v0.13.0 but latest is v0.18.0 (5 minor versions behind, ~2 years old).

The sieve-native regex matching code (evaluator.rs lines 387-437) depends on fancy_regex::escape() behavior. If fancy-regex updates, the glob-to-regex conversion could change behavior silently.

Issues:
1. Why is fancy-regex v0.13.0 specifically chosen? No comment.
2. What is the upgrade path if sieve-rs or other dependencies require a newer fancy-regex?
3. Cargo.toml has no MSRV for sieve-native (only edition 2021). If fancy-regex drops old Rust support, we're blocked.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add comment to Cargo.toml explaining fancy-regex v0.13.0 choice
- Add section to CLAUDE.md: 'Upgrading fancy-regex: test strategy'
- (Optional) Evaluate upgrading to v0.18.0 and run cross-validation tests
